newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share sentiment firm, inspiration sought.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share sentiment firm, inspiration sought.

text.p: Singapore shares firmed on Monday but general market sentiment left dealers uninspired.
"It's a Monday. I don't suppose we can expect anything spectacular," one dealer at a local firm said.
"The volume is very very flat so far," another said.
Few signs of were seen of an uplift in the immediate future, with serious investment cash likely to be sidelined until Singapore's May economic indicators are out, the dealers said.
At 0230 GMT the Straits Times Industrials Index stood up 18.88 at 2,085.09, driven mainly by blue chips Cycle & Carriage and Keppel Corp, on thin market volume of 64.3 million shares.
Cycle & Carriage was up Singapore $0.40 at S$15.30 with Keppel Corp up S$0.20 at S$6.95.

Creative Technology led 135 gainers, up S$0.70 in early trade at S$29.30, easing back from a S$29.70 record high. Creative said late on Friday it had won a preliminary injunction in a U.S. law suit against Cyrix.
Lingui Development shares led the losers, sinking S$0.88 on thin volume to a new low of S$1.62.
Osprey Maritime shares were suspended pending an announcement by the firm on takeover rumours.
